Brick walls, tiled roof, and grass up to the door

Forest Stay is a single-storey house set in its own garden. A stepping-stone path leads from the gate across the lawn to a covered veranda. Inside you'll find two bedrooms, a dining room and a kitchen, all with cool polished floors and plenty of daylight.

What's inside

  • Bedrooms

    Two bedrooms with double beds, curtains for privacy, and doors that open straight onto the garden.

  • Living and dining

    A dining table with chairs by a large curtained window, on glossy tile flooring that stays cool.

  • Kitchen

    A counter with a sink, a bottled-water dispenser, and a mesh-screened window that looks out on the trees.

  • Bathroom

    A clean, fully tiled bathroom with a window for fresh air.

  • Outdoors

    A lawn with a stepping-stone path, a gated entrance, a covered veranda and open fields past the fence.
